tools.name: check_ai_search_readiness
tools.description: Check a website's SEO basics and its AEO (AI search readiness). SEO: HTTPS, http to https redirect, noindex, viewport, title and description lengths, one h1, canonical, language, image alt text, and response time and HTML size measured from pigfox.ai's server, as seo_score out of 100 with each check

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_ai_search_readiness" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Check whether a website is ready for AI search: per-crawler robots.txt access for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and 10 more, llms.txt, the homepage's title and description lengths, canonical, language, h1 and JSON-LD types, a score out of 100, its band, and fixes w" → after: "Check a website's SEO basics and its AEO (AI search readiness). SEO: HTTPS, http to https redirect, noindex, viewport, title and description lengths, one h1, canonical, language, image alt text, and response time and HTML size measured from pigfox.ai's server, as seo_score out of 100 with each check"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
